summary: Course management includes CRUD operations, listing, searching, and validation for course data. It supports department, program, agency, cohort, filter-based queries, and handles business rules (e.g., student activity cutoffs, instructor-student ratio validity). Data includes rich fields for course structure, status, and operational flags. Validation ensures required fields and meaningful values. Workflows are defined for add, update, delete, reactivate, ratio update, and ASM update. System caches course data for performance.
purpose: To allow users (administrators, instructors, staff) to manage course records in a detailed manner, supporting workflows for searching, adding, editing, validation, and deletion, integrated with department, agency, cohort, and program context.

workflows.name: CourseAdd
steps: Validate required fields: Name, ShortName, DefaultTypeCodeID, DurationHours or calculate from DurationShifts and ShiftLength.
Apply business rules: StudentActivityCutoffDays, AllowStudentActivities.
Set course properties and parameters in DB procedure.
Execute CourseAdd database procedure.

workflows.name: CourseUpdate
steps: Validate required fields: Name, ShortName, DefaultTypeCodeID, DurationHours.
Apply business rules before saving.
Set course properties and parameters.
Execute CourseUpdate database procedure.

workflows.name: CourseDelete
steps: Call CourseDelete stored DB procedure with CourseID.
Execute query.

workflows.name: CourseReactivate
steps: Call CourseReactivate stored procedure with CourseID.
Execute query.

workflows.name: CourseUpdateRatio
steps: Validate InstructorStudentRatio: must start with '1', minimum length 3, not ':'
Error handling for invalid ratio.
Set parameters and execute CourseUpdateRatio DB procedure.

workflows.name: CourseUpdateASM
steps: Set ASM fields and conduct relevant validations.
Set parameters and execute CourseUpdateASM DB procedure.

workflows.name: CourseSearch (Department/Cohort/Agency/Staff/Filter)
steps: Set search parameters: DepartmentID, ProgramID, CohortID, TermID, CourseID, StaffID, OutboxMode, DateFrom, DateTo, etc.
Call relevant DB stored procedures.
Fill and return course lists.

business_rules: If AllowStudentActivities is false, StudentActivityCutoffDays is set to -1.
StudentActivityCutoffDays must not be less than -1.
InstructorStudentRatio must not be ':'; must start with '1' and be at least 3 characters.
Name and ShortName must be specified.
DurationHours must not be zero; if zero, calculate from DurationShifts*ShiftLength.
validations: DurationHours must not be zero; else auto-calculate.
InstructorStudentRatio format and content must be valid.
calculations: DurationHours = DurationShifts * ShiftLength (if DurationHours is zero).
conditions: CohortID and TermID != 0 for CohortCourses workflow.
NameFieldsOnly changes returned fields in CohortCourses.
system_behavior: Caches Course detail data for performance, briefly for UI refresh.
Uses stored DB procedures for CRUD and search operations.
dependencies: DB stored procedures (CourseAdd, CourseUpdate, CourseDelete, CourseReactivate, CourseUpdateRatio, CourseUpdateASM, CourseSearchDepartment, etc.)
exceptions: Validation errors: missing required fields, invalid ratios, zero duration.
If searches are called with insufficient parameters (e.g., agency not specified), empty lists returned.
content_gaps: No business logic for DepartmentRequestType except search and basic creation.
No information on UI integration specifics or error handling beyond validation.
Not all workflows describe notification or logging behavior.
